<USER_REQUEST>
Mehfil Cafe Management System: Project Plan
A personal portfolio project for Ayushi Diyora: one website that runs a whole cafe. The cafe is called Mehfil Cafe, a fictional name.
Why this idea works
This project will stand out more than Lumina Metrics or ScrapeSmart. Here is why:
• A real business problem: Recruiters see that you understand a full workflow, not just UI.
• Your skills show directly: Role-based dashboards, a real-time kitchen screen, charts and mobile-first forms.
• Plenty to talk about in interviews: "I built a complete cafe management system" is a strong line.
Biggest advice: do not build everything at once
The full system is several months of work. It is better to build it in 3 parts and put each part live than to leave it unfinished.
Version 1 (about 2 weeks): the most important part
• Login for 4 roles: owner, manager, cashier, kitchen
• Menu and tables
• The waiter takes an order from a phone, and it appears on the kitchen screen in real time
• One-click billing, with the payment mode (cash, UPI, card) saved
• Owner dashboard: today's sales, today's expenses, today's profit
Version 2: show backend depth
• Stock: milk, coffee and bread reduce automatically with every order, with low-stock alerts
• Expenses: entered with a category, plus the amount owed to each vendor
Version 3: everything else
• Staff attendance, shifts and salary
• Monthly report: best-selling items, where expenses were highest, and the real profit
Suggested tech
You already know most of this, so no time is lost learning something new:
• Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
• Supabase: Postgres database, login, and Realtime (a perfect fit for the kitchen screen)
• TanStack Query, React Hook Form + Zod, Recharts
The hard parts (each can become a LinkedIn post later)
1.  Role-based access: A cashier must not see the owner's reports. Supabase Row Level Security handles this the right way.
2.  Automatic stock reduction: Give every item a "recipe", for example 1 cappuccino = 
<truncated 7184 bytes>
─ manifest.json               # PWA, so the waiter's phone can install it
│   └── icons/
├── middleware.ts                   # redirects users away from other roles' routes
├── .env.example
└── README.md
Notes on this structure
• (app) is a route group. It shares one layout without adding "app" to the URL.
• middleware.ts is the first guard: a cashier who opens /owner is sent to their own page. The real protection is still Row Level Security in the database.
• Keep pages as server components that fetch data. Only the order cart, the kitchen board and the payment form need to be client components.
• Keep the SQL in supabase/migrations, so anyone cloning the repo can recreate the database.
• seed.sql creates the fake data and the 3 demo logins used in the README.
Build order for Version 1 (about 2 weeks)
1.  Days 1-2: Project setup, Supabase tables, login, role redirect.
2.  Days 3-4: Menu and tables screens for the manager, with the seed data.
3.  Days 5-7: Waiter order screen, which writes orders and order_items.
4.  Days 8-9: Kitchen board with Realtime and the status buttons.
5.  Days 10-11: Cashier billing screen and payments (cash, UPI, card).
6.  Days 12-13: Owner dashboard with today's sales, expenses and profit, plus the minimal expenses form.
7.  Day 14: PWA manifest, demo logins, screenshots, README, and deploy to Vercel.
Next steps
• Create the database tables in Supabase from the Database design section
• Create the GitHub repo mehfil-cafe and set up the folder structure for Version 1
• Check that mehfil-cafe.vercel.app is free and no real cafe uses the name

thinking:
Initial schema design includes eight tables: `profiles`, `products`, `categories`, `orders`, `order_items`, `payments`, `tables`, and `seating`.  The `profiles` table is the base, referencing `auth.users` with attributes for name, role (constrained to a specific set of values), active status, and creation timestamp. The remaining tables support a point-of-sale system, detailing products, categories, orders, order items, payments, tables, and seating arrangements.


`menu_categories` and `menu_items` tables defined, linked with a foreign key relationship; `menu_items` includes attributes for availability, pricing, and timestamps. Added `cafe_tables` with table label, seating capacity, and status. `orders` table incorporates table and waiter references, along with order status and timestamps. `order_items` tracks item details within orders, including quantity, and prices. `payments` table added with a reference to the `orders` table.


Payment table includes a foreign key constraint referencing the `orders` table with a restriction on deletion, payment modes as text with specific value checks, and an amount with non-negative validation. The expenses table is added to the schema. Defined indexes on key columns for querying performance. Implemented Row Level Security (RLS) across tables using the `auth.jwt()` function or checking `profiles.role`. Added a function and trigger for automatic profile creation when new users are created in the authentication system. Defined database functions to get daily dashboard statistics, including sales, expenses, and profits. Enabled realtime publication for orders, order items, and cafe tables.

-- Mehfil Cafe Management System - Version 1 Initial Schema

-- 1. Helper Function: Get user role from profiles
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_role()
RETURNS TEXT
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
$$;

-- 2. Profiles Table (Extends Supabase auth.users)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'manager', 'cashier', 'kitchen', 'waiter')),
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now())
);

-- 3. Menu Categories
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.menu_categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  sort_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- 4. Menu Items
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.menu_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.menu_categories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (price >= 0),
  is_available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,

"# Mehfil Cafe Management System: Project Plan & Discussion History

## 1. Project Concept & Vision
**Mehfil Cafe Management System** is a full-stack, role-based cafe operations platform and Point-of-Sale (POS) designed as a personal portfolio project for **Ayushi Diyora**.

### Why This Idea Stands Out
- **Solves Real Business Operational Problems:** Showcases end-to-end understanding of business workflows (floor ordering, kitchen order queuing, register settlement, daily P&L).
- **Direct Skill Demonstration:**
  - Role-based dynamic dashboards
  - Real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS) via WebSockets
  - Mobile-first Waiter PWA interface
  - Cash, UPI, and Card billing workflows
- **Strong Interview Talking Points:** Solves real technical hurdles: database-level Row Level Security (RLS), Change Data Capture (CDC), and historic price immutability.

---

## 2. Technical Stack
- **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router, Server & Client Components)
- **Language:** TypeScript 5
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
- **Database & Realtime:** Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth, Triggers, and Realtime WebSocket engine)
- **State & Data Fetching:** TanStack Query + Supabase SSR
- **Validation:** React Hook Form + Zod
- **Analytics:** Recharts

---

## 3. Version Roadmap

### Version 1 (Core POS & Live Kitchen Operations)
- Multi-role authentication & dynamic routing (`owner`, `manager`, `cashier`, `kitchen`, `waiter`)
- Digital menu catalog & interactive table management (T1–T8)
- Mobile-first waiter order entry
- Real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS) with status progression (`new` ➔ `preparing` ➔ `ready` ➔ `served`)
- One-click cashier billing with payment mode capture (`cash`, `upi`, `card`)
- Owner executive dashboard (Today's Sales, Expenses, Profit, and tender breakdown)
- PWA manifest for mobile installation

### Version 2 (Backend Depth: Inventory & Vendor Tracking)
- Recipe linkage engine (e.g. 1 Cappuccino = 200 ml milk + 18 g coffee)
- Automatic stock reduct
